record.dic_text:
3488 Narkissos {nar'-kis-sos}

同名的花, 源自 narke (麻醉之意); 陽性專有名詞

欽定本 - Narcissus 1; 1

拿其數= "愚蠢"
1)  保羅提起的一位羅馬居民 (#羅 16:11|)
record.edic_text:
3488 Narkissos {nar'-kis-sos}

a flower of the same name, from narke (stupefaction, as a
   "narcotic");; n pr m

AV - Narcissus 1; 1

Narcissus = "stupidity"
1) a dweller at Rome mentioned by Paul in Rom. 16:11
